# meraki_appliance_routing_vrfs_settings (Data Source)

This data source can read the `Appliance Routing VRFs Settings` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meraki_appliance_routing_vrfs_settings" "example" {
  organization_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Boolean indicating whether VRFs are enabled for the organization.
- `id` (String) The id of the object
